findings.body: Raise: Functional. After `forge land` hands out a fix round, `worker.work` records the item as `fixing`. A subsequent `forge land` skips this startup condition, which covers only `started` and `working`, and enters `close.close` while the subagent still holds the round. Close can run tests or review against unfinished work before the busy lock is checked. A rerun during a handed-out fix round should stop at that round.
findings.title: Land can close while a native fix round is still running
